quote: Inclusion criteria were age (18-65 years), obesity (body mass index [BMI] of 32-43 [calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared]), and safe contraceptive method or postmenopausal status.
Exclusion criteria were any known serious chronic illness, including diabetes.
The study was conducted from August 2016 to November 2019 at Hvidovre Hospital and the Department of Biomedical Sciences of the University of Copenhagen, Denmark.

A total of 195 participants [...] were randomized to the exercise group (48 participants), liraglutide group (49 participants), combination group (49 participants), or placebo group (49 participants).
Participants were encouraged to attend group exercise sessions 2 times per week and to perform exercise individually 2 times per week.

Liraglutide or volume-matched placebo was administered as once daily subcutaneous injections in the abdomen. The starting dose was 0.6 mg/day with weekly increments of 0.6 mg until reaching a dose of 3.0 mg/day.

Participants who lost at least 5% of their initial body weight were then randomly assigned to a 1-year intervention phase with either exercise and placebo (exercise group), liraglutide (liraglutide group), a combination of exercise and liraglutide (combination group), or placebo (placebo group).

BMD in grams per centimeter squared was measured with DXA in fasting state separately at the left hip and lumbar spine (L1-L4), which are considered the important sites for assessments of fracture risk and treatment response, respectively.
In the combination group, BMD was unchanged compared with the placebo group at the hip [...] P = .24) and lumbar spine [...] P = .20).
In the liraglutide group, hip BMD decreased compared with the exercise group [...] P = .03) and placebo group [...] P = .02).
Likewise, in the liraglutide group, lumbar spine BMD decreased compared with the exercise group [...] P = .04) and placebo group [...] P = .02).
Distal forearm BMD increased in the exercise and combination groups, with no differences between the 4 groups regarding distal forearm BMD.
Compared with placebo, the liraglutide and combination treatments were associated with increased whole-body BMD (eFigure 2 in Supplement 2 ).
In response to the 8-week low-calorie diet, P-CTX increased by a mean of 27% [...] P-P1NP increased by a mean of 7% [...] at week 52, P1NP had returned to the initial levels in all 4 groups.
Changes in BMD were calculated from before the low-calorie diet to 1 year after randomization.
This study is a predefined secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial [...]
